resources.title: AI Engineering Architecture Infographic (1 of 4)
resources.description: How modern AI applications actually work: the core components of an AI solution (Python, APIs, LLMs, embeddings, vector databases, inference), a real-world example (Northfield Retail wants an AI assistant that answers employee questions from company docs), the full RAG-ready AI application architecture (ingest & chunk, create embeddings, store in a vector DB, LLM, cited answer), the key skills an AI Engineer builds (Python, API integration, LLMs & prompt engineering, embeddings & vector search, cloud AI, containers, CI/CD & monitoring), sample Python using an LLM with your own data, and real business use cases (employee knowledge assistant, AI data analyst, document intelligence, AI agent/task automation).

resources.title: RAG Explained: Building an AI That Answers Using Your Own Documents Infographic (2 of 4)
resources.description: What Retrieval-Augmented Generation is and why it matters: using your organization's real data for more accurate, trustworthy answers, reducing hallucinations, and keeping data private. Walks through the full 6-step RAG process (collect documents, chunk content, create embeddings, store in a vector database, retrieve relevant chunks, generate the answer), the complete RAG architecture showing how knowledge sources, ingestion, embeddings, the vector database, and the LLM fit together, a real sample prompt sent to the LLM with retrieved context and citations, how vector search actually works (embeddings as points in space, finding the nearest neighbors), and a technology-options table for each component (document ingestion, embeddings, vector database, LLM, deployment).

resources.title: AI Agents: How AI Uses Tools, SQL, APIs & Human Approval Infographic (3 of 4)
resources.description: What an AI agent is and how it goes beyond answering questions to taking real action: the agent architecture (plan, reason, use tools, act & respond, with memory/state maintained throughout), the tools an agent can use (SQL, APIs, email, files, business systems), what's actually happening inside the agent's "brain" (planning, reasoning, memory), a real sales-manager scenario walked step by step (get data, analyze, summarize, send for approval, email the final report), sample agent pseudocode, and the human-in-the-loop approval flow that keeps an agent safe before it takes a final action.

resources.title: Production AI Engineering: From Prototype to Enterprise Infographic (4 of 4)
resources.description: Turning a working AI prototype into a secure, reliable, scalable production application: the full production architecture (users -> FastAPI layer -> RAG + AI agent core -> data & tools -> deploy & operate with Docker/Kubernetes/Azure/AWS), a real-world business outcome example, the real-world tech stack (Python, FastAPI, Docker, Kubernetes, Azure AI, AWS, GitHub), a sample FastAPI RAG endpoint, security & guardrails (authentication, input/output guardrails, data protection, responsible AI, audit logging), a real AI application monitoring dashboard (uptime, latency, requests, cost), performance & cost optimization (caching, retrieval tuning, right-sizing the model), and a full CI/CD deployment pipeline.
